title: Prisma rail: plans and wheres
routing: Is this about turning a rule into a Prisma query: toPrisma(rule, { map, model, mapName | lens, now }) returning a plan `{ steps }`, running its groupBy / count steps and `{ __field }` column references with executePrismaPlan(plan, delegate), or combining compiled wheres with andWhere / orWhere / matchAll / matchNothing? Also Json null checks (AnyNull from @prisma/client), Json filter mapping, relation counts and sums. Jobs: filter a findMany by a saved rule, users with at least three published posts, users whose orders sum past a thousand, add the org scope to a compiled filter.
